articles.title: Beijing 1733 ByteDance Commercial Project / XU Studio
articles.summary: In highly rational and efficiently operated office parks, how can commercial spaces evolve beyond their role as functional amenities and become shared environments with a sense of life and warmth? The Beijing 1733 Public Space Renovation responds to this question through a strategy of lightweight intervention. articles.title: Sangwich Club / east bureau
articles.summary: Sangwich Club is a 109.3-square-meter sandwich bar in central Almaty , designed by east bureau as a place that reveals itself gradually. Rather than building the interior around a single visual gesture, the project brings together the existing character of the space, the brand's visual language, and a series of custom-designed elements that echo one another throughout the interior.

articles.title: Dumas Sea Face Masterplan / INI Design Studio
articles.summary: For decades, Surat's relationship with the Arabian Sea was shaped by a fragmented and underutilized shoreline. The Dumas Sea Face Masterplan reimagines this edge as a living coastal landscape, transforming a neglected waterfront into a resilient public realm where ecology, civic life, and urban identity converge. Located along the historic Dumas coastline, the project responds to the growing demand for high-quality public open space in one of India's fastest-growing cities. articles.title: AA Apartments / Crearctive
articles.summary: The project addresses the change of use of commercial premises to transform them into four independent apartments. Taking advantage of the open-plan layout of the original space and its generous clear height of thirteen feet (four meters), the proposal resolves the distribution by designing the void and working in section. The strategy relies on a central spine that groups the service spaces, which optimizes the layout of the building systems, frees up the perimeter of the home, and allows for the articulation of an intermediate level that makes the most of the height of the space.

articles.title: MAGMA House / SUITE
articles.summary: Under the theme "Mind and Heart" of CASACOR São Paulo 2026, Casa MAGMA occupies 215 m² with curves, tactile textures, and earthy tones, proposing an experience of warmth and introspection.

articles.title: Colares Sintra House / Sabrab
articles.summary: Set within a pine forest of stone pines in Colares, overlooking the vineyards and the slopes of the Sintra Mountains, the house is the result of transforming an existing villa into a contemporary living space, open to the garden and the landscape.

articles.title: Shanghai Grand Opera House / Snøhetta
articles.summary: Set along the Huangpu River, the Shanghai Grand Opera House emerges as a new cultural landmark for one of the world's most dynamic cities. As an open cultural landscape, it brings together a world-class performing arts venue and an accessible public realm – inviting residents and visitors alike to engage with culture, architecture, and urban life. Rooted in Shanghai's spirit of openness, exchange, and innovation, the project broadens access to culture while creating a new platform for artistic expression and civic engagement.

articles.title: Diana Kellogg updates her Tribeca home using salvaged materials
articles.summary: New York architect Diana Kellogg has renovated her historic Tribeca residence, highlighting materials repurposed from its industrial past. Kellogg and her family have occupied the home on Staple Street for 25 years, which is close to the studio that the architect shares with her filmmaker husband.
